2609.09882.title: Scored vs. Generated Readouts in Behavioral Language Models: An Empirical Study of Elicitation Format
2609.09882.paper_summary: Language models fine-tuned on customer behavior can predict outcomes and generate explanations, but these readouts are often treated as interchangeable. Holding model checkpoint and prompt content fixed, we compare probabilities obtained by scoring answer tokens with predictions generated after a written rationale. Across 13 model-domain cells covering four retail tasks in three markets, including two using fully public data and checkpoints, the scored readout ranks outcomes more accurately in 12 of 13 cells (two-sided sign test, p approximately 0.003), by 1.5 to 14.5 points in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Paired bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero in every newly measured cell. The gap varies with task-specific supervision and mismatch between training and serving formats, ranging from -2.2 points for an untuned base model to +13.7 for rationale-format supervision. Analysis of approximately 9,000 rationales identifies two correlates: reduced reliance on the dominant predictive feature and convergence on stock formulations. Probability saturation does not track the gap. A third readout, eliciting a probability before any verdict, improves calibration (Brier score from 0.47 to 0.15) while ranking within noise of scoring, but only for outcome rates represented in training; it is worse than scoring when the scored head is already calibrated. We interpret these differences through the objectives matched by each readout, identify training choices that narrow the gap, and propose retaining generated rationales while sourcing ranking from the scored head.
2609.09882.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型在客戶行為上進行微調，可以預測結果並生成解釋，但這些讀數通常被視為可互換的。保持模型檢查點和提示內容不變，我們比較通過評分答案標記獲得的概率與在書面理由後生成的預測。在涵蓋三個市場的四個零售任務中，包括兩個使用完全公開數據和檢查點的模型領域單元中，評分的讀數在13個單元中的12個單元中更準確地排名結果（雙側符號檢驗，p約為0.003），在接收器操作特徵曲線下的面積（AUC）中提高了1.5到14.5分。配對自助法信賴區間在每個新測量的單元中都排除了零。這一差距隨著任務特定的監督和訓練與服務格式之間的不匹配而變化，範圍從未調整的基礎模型的-2.2分到理由格式監督的+13.7分。對約9,000個理由的分析確定了兩個相關因素：對主導預測特徵的依賴減少以及對庫存公式的收斂。概率飽和度並未跟蹤這一差距。第三個讀數，在任何裁決之前引出概率，改善了校準（Brier分數從0.47降至0.15），同時在評分的噪音範圍內排名，但僅對訓練中表示的結果率而言；當評分的頭部已經校準時，它的表現不如評分。我們通過每個讀數所匹配的目標來解釋這些差異，確定縮小差距的訓練選擇，並建議保留生成的理由，同時從評分的頭部獲取排名。
